question: How do Vishnu-and-rest, knowing the sole Shaiva ultimate, yet resort to deluded dissent?
inference: Ultimate-knowing Vishnu-ones still initiate some into deluded dissent.
uncertainties: vimati reading kept per gloss; independent verification pending
plain_english: Thus Vishnu-and-the-rest, Shaiva-ultimate-sole knowers — toward some, so initiated; from delusion, dissent resorted.
